convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMA indicators for signal generation. Simple crossover entry/exit rules. Fixed lot or risk-percent position sizing. No external .mqh dependencies for trading logic. All standard MT5 API calls.

other_exits: Opposite crossover signal closes existing position before opening new one

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative Lots value = fixed lot sizing (absolute value used). Positive Lots value = fraction of free margin to risk (Lots/100 as percentage).

custom_logic_notes: Universal MA crossover EA. Fast MA crossing above Slow MA triggers long; crossing below triggers short. Signal reversal closes opposite position before entering new one. Position sizing is dual-mode: negative input = fixed lots, positive input = fraction of free margin. SL/TP values are adjusted for 5-digit brokers (multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001). Margin check performed before order placement. New bar detection used to prevent multiple entries per bar. Filling mode auto-adapted to broker support (FOK preferred, then IOC, then RETURN).
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Use ta-lib or pandas-ta for EMA calculation. Implement new-bar guard using bar timestamp comparison. Digit adjustment logic: if price_decimals >= 5, multiply SL/TP in points by 10. Position sizing dual-mode: negative=lots, positive=margin_fraction. Ensure position check (no existing trade) before entry. Close opposite position on signal reversal before opening new trade.
